subject: Check Sentinel config dir is writable at startup (#5376)
reason: The change adds a startup-only check inside sentinelCheckConfigFile(), called solely under `if (server.sentinel_mode)` (src/server.c:8138); Sentinel mode is selected by argv0/--sentinel, not by any server config. The fuzzer has no Sentinel deployment mode, valkey.action.commands' private servers and all installed experiments start plain valkey-server (standalone or cluster), and valkey.action.tools runs only valkey-cli/valkey-benchmark/valkey-check-rdb/valkey-check-aof, so no composition of installed components can start a process that executes the changed code. Non-Sentinel behavior is untouc
